snippet.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate - Krystal's Trailer
snippet.description:
Sorry for the bad video editing. This is a moveset from  @snekmods764  Krystal mod over Dark Pit including his trailer reveal art. This moveset took me more than one year to finish. Finally i can play as my most wanted Smash Bros fighter!

The moveset can be downloaded here: https://gamebanana.com/mods/514829

The original mod can be downloaded here: https://gamebanana.com/mods/175016
